gen-zen-dots-gf-m-plus-code-latin: Zen Dots gives each letter generous room as a friendly, techy display face, while M PLUS Code Latin bends neon-tube lines. The heading carries the shouting, and the body quietly keeps the sentences moving.
gen-zen-dots-gf-m-plus-rounded-1c: Zen Dots is a friendly, techy display face with room around every letter. M PLUS Rounded 1c, a sans whose terminals stop short of curling back, would read smoothly paragraph after paragraph without any fuss.
gen-zen-dots-gf-manjari: Zen Dots is a tech-flavored display face with friendly, generous openings, set against Manjari, whose unclosed curves keep a steady line. One is built to grab attention; the other is built to carry text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-meera-inimai: Zen Dots brings a friendly, techy display look with generous room around each letter. Meera Inimai follows with blueprint-lettering lines of one thickness and curves left open to breathe.
gen-zen-dots-gf-metrophobic: Zen Dots is the friendly, techy one, made to show off. Metrophobic, plain sans through and through, does the quieter job of guiding the eye smoothly around each bend of running text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-mina: Techy and friendly, Zen Dots leaves generous room around each letter, while Mina draws strokes as plain as stitched thread. Loud display letters above, a hushed sans below to carry the text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-mingzat: Techy but friendly: Zen Dots gives every display letter generous room to breathe. Mingzat, a sans-serif with curvy, unclamped letters, takes over for the text and keeps the mood relaxed.
gen-zen-dots-gf-moderustic: Zen Dots is a friendly, techy display face that leaves generous room around every letter. Moderustic, plain sans with curves traced by a broad nib and left unfinished, takes the text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-molengo: Friendly tech energy: Zen Dots leaves generous room around every letter, while Molengo keeps wide gaps that stay crisp at tiny sizes. Zen Dots makes the entrance; Molengo, plain sans, does the detail work.
gen-zen-dots-gf-mona-sans: Mona Sans reads with openings as wide as a door left ajar, tucked under the techy Zen Dots heading. And the standout trait is generosity, since both fonts leave plenty of room around their letters.
